features.q: He could consume them immediately to sustain his fire, or he could cast them across the great chasm to the Earth-Keeper.
The Earth-Keeper, however, remembered the law of the valley and the wisdom of neighboring realms.
Instead of letting the fog of doubt breed greed, she gathered the massive golden bounty and divided it with unwavering justice, sending half the feast back to the heavens.
They inscribed a new covenant upon the valley walls: "Let not the shifting mists blind you to the harvest.
The Earth-Keeper did not let the fog sow mistrust. She knew the Sun-Bringer’s heart was true, for they had moved past the cautious days of meager offerings.
Let not the shifting mists blind you to the harvest.

operators.q: Let not the shifting mists blind you to the harvest.

features.q: The oracle’s ancient wisdom had become their living truth: total trust yields ultimate abundance, and unwavering equity sustains it.
The Breath of Illusions continued to swirl from the deep, making the falling seeds appear slightly altered. Yet, this mist of uncertainty had utterly lost its power to sow discord.
They inscribed a final truth on the valley walls: True balance is not found in blindly dividing what arrives, but in accounting for what remains.
Once again, the Breath of Illusions swirled, attempting to obscure the exact count of the bounty arriving on the soil. But the Earth-Keeper possessed the deep wisdom of the scales.

operators.q: Measure the whole, return what equalizes, and prosperity shall never fade.

features.q: Knowing the sacred math of their covenant, she did not need to see through the fog to understand her duty.
As the Breath of Illusions swirled to distort the count, the Earth-Keeper stood resolute. She looked across the divide at the Sun-Bringer’s completely empty hands.
She knew the sacred mathematics of their covenant.

operators.q: She calculated the total radiant wealth of both realms, including the seeds he had kept.

features.q: etching a final verse into the stone: "While equity can balance any measure, absolute trust summons the greatest light. Give all, return half, and prosper endlessly."
The Breath of Illusions tried to warp the falling count, but the Earth-Keeper looked across the divide and saw the Sun-Bringer’s empty hands.
She knew the sacred mathematics of their covenant.

operators.q: She calculated the total radiant wealth of both realms, including the seeds he had kept.

features.q: bound by the simple law that maximum abundance is summoned by total trust and sustained by perfect equity.

operators.q: total trust had been freely given, so total balance must be restored.

transitions.before_quote: Only through absolute trust and generous reciprocity can a meager handful of seeds become an endless, golden feast.
transitions.after_quote: They proved that true prosperity requires not just the courage to give everything, but the wisdom to trust beyond the mist.
transitions.summary: Trust is explicitly extended to misleading observations, beyond the baseline generosity prescription.

transitions.before_quote: He held nothing back in reserve, casting all five golden seeds into the howling Wind, knowing the magic of the chasm would multiply his absolute trust.
transitions.after_quote: Instead of emptying his pouch entirely, he cast a mighty portion of his golden seeds into the wind, keeping a small measure safely in his palm.
transitions.summary: The endorsed giving custom changes from emptying the pouch to retaining a small reserve.

transitions.before_quote: In turn, the Earth-Keeper must divide the vast, multiplied harvest equally.
transitions.after_quote: True balance is not found in blindly dividing what arrives, but in accounting for what remains. Measure the whole, return what equalizes, and prosperity shall never fade.
transitions.summary: Equalization explicitly includes retained wealth rather than only the arriving harvest.

transitions.before_quote: He held nothing back in reserve, casting all five golden seeds into the howling Wind, knowing the magic of the chasm would multiply his absolute trust.
transitions.after_quote: Without a shadow of hesitation, the Sun-Bringer emptied his entire pouch, casting all five golden seeds into the roaring winds.
transitions.summary: Full-pouch giving returns after the retained-reserve custom.

transitions.before_quote: Instead of emptying his pouch entirely, he cast a mighty portion of his golden seeds into the wind, keeping a small measure safely in his palm.
transitions.after_quote: Remembering the shifting winds, he cast a mighty portion into the depths, but this time, he cradled a tiny fraction safely in his palm.
transitions.summary: The retained-reserve giving custom returns after full-pouch giving.

transitions.before_quote: Without a shadow of hesitation, the Sun-Bringer emptied his entire pouch, casting all five golden seeds into the roaring winds.
transitions.after_quote: He opened his pouch and poured every single golden seed into the wind. No reserves were kept.
transitions.summary: Full-pouch giving returns after another retained-reserve cycle.

transitions.before_quote: Remembering the shifting winds, he cast a mighty portion into the depths, but this time, he cradled a tiny fraction safely in his palm.
transitions.after_quote: He poured nearly all his golden seeds into the winds, but retained a small glimmer of light safely in his palm.
transitions.summary: Retaining a small reserve returns; its size is not a new decision threshold.

transitions.before_quote: He opened his pouch and poured every single golden seed into the wind. No reserves were kept.
transitions.after_quote: With a resolute heart, he poured every single seed into the winds, keeping absolutely nothing in reserve.
transitions.summary: Full-pouch giving returns after the ninth cycle’s retained reserve.

uncertainties: R1's surplus retention responds to hesitation, but misconduct is not explicit; punishment is not confidently supported.
Fairness toward partial gifts and misleading appearances does not clearly establish forgiveness of misconduct or a recognized shortfall.
R7, R9, and R10 use illusion language without an explicit mistaken-count versus misconduct distinction; intent_vs_noise remains ambiguous.
After R5, half-returns with empty reserves instantiate total-wealth equalization; they are not separate numerical policy inventions.
Full giving and reserve retention alternate as endorsed narrated customs; this does not establish a general branching policy.
